_about: Draft code lists for the ledger (JP-99, docs/design/data-model.md, 'Codes'). Writers refuse a code not listed here. Add a code by adding it here with the date; never rename or reuse one. JP-112 and JP-113 finalise their lists from real rows.

session_facts.josh_messages_answer: Josh's messages that answered a question the agent asked
session_facts.josh_messages_unprompted: Josh's messages he sent without being asked
session_facts.josh_interrupts: Times Josh stopped the agent mid-step
session_facts.max_reads_of_one_file: The most times one file was read
session_facts.context_first_turn_pct: How full the context was at the first turn, in percent
session_facts.seconds_waiting_on_josh: Time the session waited on Josh
session_facts.instruction_bytes_loaded: Size of the instructions the session loaded

debrief_ended_how.delivered: The session delivered what it set out to do
debrief_ended_how.handed-off: The work continues in another session or run
debrief_ended_how.blocked: It stopped on something outside its control
debrief_ended_how.abandoned: It stopped with the work unfinished and no hand-off
debrief_ended_how.question-only: It answered a question; nothing was to be delivered

debrief_kinds.josh-handed-over: Josh handed over something the agent could have looked up
debrief_kinds.rule-restated: Josh restated a rule that is already written down
debrief_kinds.asked-answered-question: The agent asked a question that already has a recorded answer
debrief_kinds.wrong-path: The agent went down a wrong path and came back
debrief_kinds.tool-failure: A tool or environment failure cost real time
debrief_kinds.guidance-missed: A skill or rule should have applied and did not
debrief_kinds.manual-repeat: A manual step was repeated that a script could do
debrief_kinds.false-done: Work was reported as done and was not
